title: better-auth 1.3.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a race condition in the emailOTP plugin…
description: better-auth versions 1.3.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contain a race condition vulnerability in the emailOTP plugin. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass allowed attempt limits by sending concurrent guesses, potentially enabling brute-force attacks on one-time passwords (OTPs) for sign-in or password resets. Additionally, signed-in users can verify email addresses they do not own, and attackers receiving mail at accent-variant email addresses can reset victims' passwords.
